title: Apply kinetic energy formula

hook.scenario: Ek ruka hua cricket ball aapko halke se lage toh kuch nahi hota. Par agar wahi ball Shoaib Akhtar ki speed se aaye, toh haddi tod sakti hai.
hook.question: Motion ki wajah se is ball mein kaunsi chhupee hui takat aa gayi?

mental_model.intuition: Motion = Kinetic Energy. Jitni tezz raftaar aur jitna bhari object, utni zyada Kinetic Energy.
mental_model.description: Koi bhi cheez agar chal rahi hai, toh uske motion ki wajah se usme energy hoti hai jise Kinetic Energy kehte hain. Ye energy object ke mass aur uski speed (velocity) par depend karti hai.

explanation:
Kinetic energy (KE) us energy ko bolte hain jo kisi object ke paas uske motion ki wajah se hoti hai. Ek girti hui coconut, ek udta hua hawai jahaz, ek behti hui hawa, in sabme kinetic energy hoti hai. Agar object stationary hai (ruka hua), toh uski kinetic energy strictly zero hoti hai.

Kinetic energy nikalne ka ek fixed mathematical formula hai: `Ek = 1/2 m v^2`. Yahan `m` object ka mass hai (kilograms mein), aur `v` uski uniform velocity hai (meters per second mein). 

Is formula se hume do bahut important baatein pata chalti hain. Pehli, kinetic energy mass ke directly proportional hoti hai. Agar mass double kiya, toh KE bhi double hogi. Dusri aur sabse khaas baat, kinetic energy velocity ke square par depend karti hai (`v^2`). Iska matlab agar aap kisi car ki speed double karte ho, toh uski kinetic energy 2 ka square, yaani 4 times badh jayegi! Yahi reason hai ki high speed par accidents zyada khatarnak hote hain kyunki gaadi mein energy exponentially badh jati hai.

key_points.title: Kinetic Energy Formula
key_points.detail: Ek = 1/2 m v^2, where m is mass in kg and v is velocity in m/s.

key_points.title: Dependence on Velocity
key_points.detail: Kinetic energy is proportional to the square of its velocity. If velocity doubles, kinetic energy quadruples.

worked_example.problem: An object of mass 15 kg is moving with a uniform velocity of 4 m/s. What is the kinetic energy possessed by the object?

steps.narration: Pehle mass aur velocity ki values note karo, aur check karo ki units standard hain ya nahi.
Values substitute karke solve karo. Dhyan rakhna ki v ka square karna hai.

worked_example.problem: An archer shoots an arrow of mass 0.2 kg with a velocity of 50 m/s. Calculate the kinetic energy of the arrow.

steps.narration: Mass aur velocity diye gaye hain, units check karo.

common_mistakes.title: Forgetting to square the velocity
common_mistakes.explanation: Bahut baar formula yaad hota hai par jaldi mein log sirf (1/2 * m * v) karke aa jaate hain. Velocity (v) ka square karna mat bhoolna!

common_mistakes.title: Not converting km/h to m/s
common_mistakes.explanation: Agar speed km/h mein di ho, toh pehle use 5/18 se multiply karke m/s mein convert karna zaroori hai, warna answer bilkul galat aayega.

recall_questions.q: What is the formula for kinetic energy?
How does kinetic energy change if the mass of the object is doubled?
How does kinetic energy change if the velocity is doubled?
recall_questions.answer: The kinetic energy becomes four times its original value.

oa_questions.question: What is the kinetic energy of an object?
oa_questions.answer: The energy possessed by an object due to its motion.
oa_questions.approach: State the definition straight from the concept.

oa_questions.question: The kinetic energy of an object of mass m moving with a velocity of 5 m/s is 25 J. What will be its kinetic energy when its velocity is doubled?
oa_questions.approach: Since velocity is doubled, KE becomes 2^2 = 4 times. 4 * 25 J = 100 J.
